_說明: 作品清單。改完跑 `node build.mjs` 就會重新產生所有頁面。
平常用後台改（node tools/admin.mjs）比手改安全，欄位都有說明與檢查。
每一筆的欄位：
slug     網址用（work/<slug>.html），也是 assets/media/<slug>/ 的資料夾名
title    顯示標題
year     年份，可留空
role     類型，顯示在資訊列右半邊
client   客戶名稱，有填才會出現
tags     標籤陣列
summary  搜尋引擎摘要，只用在 <meta description>，不會顯示在頁面上
thumb    首頁縮圖 { file, w, h }
span     首頁佔幾欄，留空 = 4 欄；ratio 可以個別指定縮圖比例
cardColor  首頁滑過縮圖時蓋上去的顏色
draft    設 true 就不會產生這一頁，資料留著
hideFromGrid  有頁面但不出現在首頁
封面：
cover          用哪一張當封面 { file, w, h }。留空 = 用 thumb 那張。
選到的圖如果也排在 blocks 裡，內文那張會自動略過，不會重複。
coverPosition  圖在封面框裡的位置，"50% 50%" 這種兩個百分比。預設居中。
封面是裁切填滿的，這個值決定看得到哪一塊 —— 直式素材預設
只看得到中段，往上拖就是 "50% 0%"。
coverScale     放大倍率，1 ~ 3。1（或留空）= 剛好填滿。小於 1 會露出空邊，
所以不接受。放大的基準點會跟著 coverPosition 走。
這兩個值在後台是拖曳與滑桿，不必手寫。
coverTopDark   封面上緣是深色（由 tools/set-card-colors.mjs 量出來的），
右上角的選單會自動轉白色。改了封面構圖要重跑那支腳本。
blocks   內頁區塊，順序就是頁面上的順序：
{ type:"media", file, w, h, caption, alt }       圖片或影片
{ type:"embed", provider:"vimeo", id, caption }  Vimeo
{ type:"text", text }                            段落（換行會保留）
{ type:"heading", text, level }                  小標
開頭連續的 text 區塊會被搬到資訊列當作品簡介。
每個區塊可以自己決定寬度與位置：
width      "70%" 這種寬度，留空 = 依比例自動收窄
col / span 放在 12 欄網格的哪幾欄（例如 col 7 span 6 = 右半邊）
設了 col/span 之後 width 就不生效，位置說了算
newRow     true = 強制另起一列，即使這一列還放得下
localFile  同一件作品裡有不同的圖同名時，指定存在本機的檔名
（Cargo 用 hash 定址所以允許同名，本機會互相蓋掉）

blocks.text: He is Tommy. Tommy is a Chihuahua and was also the first pet dog I ever had. He was a shy and quiet little boy, and he was my best companion. I had him from when I was 10 years old until last year, when I was 26.
When I was about 13, I was standing on the street when Tommy suddenly peed on my foot!
People often say that dogs pee to mark their territory. I like to think of it as his own unique way of showing love.

He passed away last year. When I think back on all the love he gave us, I want to record that funny and touching memory to thank him for growing up with me. I’m using the way I know best to preserve it  through my own creations.
He is Tommy.

blocks.text: "I guess I'll go back to using the computer for 3D 😭."
This is a sentence my friend, who taught me pottery most frequently in the second half of last year, said. One day, I had an epiphany! It's okay to start with 3D!

The starting point of this project is small, a bit whimsical, purely to fulfill my small wish. The main idea is to digitally sculpt pottery on the computer, trying to maintain the steps of making pottery and using shapes to record a certain day, creating the image in my mind. However, I won't give up on making pottery entirely, after all, the unique surprises that come out every time it's fired are indeed one of the joys of pottery!

blocks.text: Last month, I traveled to Osaka and visited Katsuo-ji Temple, which was one of my favorite spots throughout the trip. The temple was filled with adorable Daruma dolls.

Later, I looked up information about Daruma and was amazed to learn that the dolls represent a legendary monk who meditated facing a wall for nine years, causing his arms and legs to atrophy, resulting in the unique shape we see today. Knowing this, I couldn‘t resist creating an animated Daruma doll secretly stretching its limbs when no one was watching.

blocks.text: I have always loved the traditional Taiwanese ceramic tiles and mosaic tile bathtubs that can be found at my grandmother's house. Even now, the tiles on the walls and floors of my childhood home's kitchen are still these traditional floral tiles! They are really adorable! When I was a child, I would even count the tiles in the mosaic tile bathtub, and I remember how slippery it was and how afraid I was of slipping inside.

Traditional Taiwanese tulip-patterned ceramic tiles are most commonly used in kitchens and bathrooms. As for traditional mosaic tile bathtubs, they are made of colorful stones in five different hues: red, green, blue, white, and yellow. These materials evoke a sense of nostalgia and are considered traditional building materials in Taiwan.

projects.summary: “Rudolph” is an interactive projection table game. The goal of the game is to collect as much garbage as possible in 100 seconds. There are up and downhill
projects._summary註: summary 只用於 <meta description>，不會顯示在頁面上

blocks.text: “Rudolph” is an interactive projection table game. The goal of the game is to collect as much garbage as possible in 100 seconds. There are up and downhills and rivers in the game, also the traps of the spike, which might let players undergo the short-lived death.
Players have three actual item boards respectively used as three different functions.
For example, Rudolph can jump with the “pudding” board, the “conveyor belt” makes Rudolph speed up, and the “fan” helps to move further.

There are also many different terrains in the game. Players need to put each item board in the proper places and have the flexibility to use them under time pressure to get points, which gives players excitement and pleasure.
